scenarios.name: After the Juicer
scenarios.subtitle: Floor 01 refuge: a wrecked gym, a heavy bag and the way to the arena
scenarios.purpose: A 1280 px quiet room (REST-C, REST-AD12, REST-AD13): one continuous ground lane, no enemy, no hazard, no lock. The plan's optional 24 px bench cannot be a platform (the validator's lane rule), so it is decor (REST-IMP-8). The wrecked-gym decor, the 112 px blink lane marked on the floor and the circular grooves are decor rectangles in src/f01_rest.rs; the heavy bag is an inert sidecar static (a hit_target without a machine).
scenarios.expected: Spawns, the checkpoint before the exit, the exit and the heavy bag come from f01_rest_aftermath.encounter.json; this file holds geometry only. The room grants nothing: the mastery pin the room carries already holds the Juicer's grants, so no duplicate unlock fires.
scenarios.coop: Solo or two players: the route is base movement for every class; the blink lane is an optional Puddle Jumper test for Donut and never blocks.
